Split tests/cli.rs (35334 lines, 515 tests) into single cli target at tests/cli/main.rs with shared support and per-command modules, all <=1500 lines (max 1173).

- Baseline before: wc -l 35334, 515 #[test], cargo test --test cli -- --list 515. After: rg sums 515, list 515, match.
